reviews.text: This practice of Medivet is unique. They are all personable and helpful and with any and all questions, they aim to help get things sorted.  Tom Robert’s, leading the team, is always calm and takes time to listen to concerns.  I think they are really great and recommend them highly.

We had an emergency visit on Sunday to the Medivet office on the Gloucester Road.   Sarah and Tom did a great job helping our Frenchie Hugo, who injured his neck.  He was quickly examined and prescribed pain and inflammation medicine.  Fingers crossed he is on the mend.  A big thank you to Medivet Kensington and to Sarah and Tom.
Amazing team and amazing doctors!

What a brilliant veterinary practice!
Open 24/7
The team are absolutely lovely and helpful 🙏
The vets are knowledgeable and very kind to animals
I’d recommend them 100%

We had a very positive experience with this veterinary clinic. The staff were professional, friendly and genuinely caring, and everything was explained clearly without making us feel rushed.

I was particularly impressed with their healthcare plan. It is practical, well organised and offers good value for ongoing and preventative care.

After our visit, I feel confident trusting them with my dog’s health. We are very happy to join their healthcare programme and look forward to becoming regular clients.

Thank you to the whole team for such a welcoming and reassuring experience!

I think they are making things up as they go along. I have found the staff to be lacking in professionalism - particularly the phone staff. Lack of communication skills is permeating across the staff, including vets. Very disappointing.
I unfortunately have had to visit here the last couple of weekends because of my poorly dog, however they are AMAZING..from the receptionists to the vet 5* all the way ..definitely recommend
Excellent service I’ve seen most of the vets there and all have been friendly and seem to genuinely care. Reception is always super helpful and polite too

Very disappointing experience after being a loyal Medivet client for several years.

I arrived 15 minutes late for my cat’s annual vaccination appointment, and I completely understand that veterinary practices are busy and appointments run to a schedule. However, I was very disappointed with how the situation was handled.

I had actually called the practice earlier to reschedule the appointment, so when I arrived, I was surprised that the receptionist couldn’t locate my appointment. She then had to ask her colleagues who had booked me in for the later time, which suggested there was some confusion within the practice about the appointment itself.

Despite this, I was simply told that I couldn’t be seen and would have to come back three hours later. Given that I was only 15 minutes late, and particularly considering I had already contacted the practice about changing the appointment, I felt there could have been a little more understanding and flexibility.

After being with Medivet for several years, I expected a more welcoming and compassionate approach, especially when it comes to something as important as my cat’s care. Unfortunately, this experience has left me feeling very disappointed and questioning whether I should continue with the practice.

I hope the practice can take this feedback on board. Veterinary care is not just about the treatment itself, how clients and their pets are treated also matters.
Excellent care and attention to my dog
The most important for me how they take care my dogs. They really kind and gentle with them. I really appreciate it.  Reception so nice and help me with all information. Vet are amazing.
My family and I have total confidence in the team at our Medivet in Kensington. Even our dog is always happy to go there, despite having had injections, and recently being spayed.
Thank you for all your kind help.What a lovely welcoming place.Great team of people.

The lovely Spanish vet helped me in a very scary situation and made me feel extremely comfortable after my dog was bitten by a fox. I am so grateful for her incredible service and reassuring me so much. Can’t rate this vet higher and I’ve tried almost every vet in London ha 🙏 Thank you all. …

Unbelievably good experience with Saul from the Kensington branch. He can only be described as brilliant. He’s the first vet in 8 years who’s managed to take our dogs blood! Shows how incredible he is. A huge thank you to him and the rest of the team.

Great experience with MediVet. I’ve been taking my Chihuahua there for a few years now and trust this practice. Our Vet Vishaal Corpaul has been extremely diligent and helpful. He never pushes an agenda and is consistently supportive, informative and very professional. Highly recommend him & his team!

Called them on a mid nyt emergency for my dog

Staff were very quick to respond and treat the dog

Very happy with the service
Such a kind, knowledgeable and caring team. They made a tough experience with our cat’s amputation, as smooth and supportive as possible. Thank you so much to everyone here.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely brilliant experience at Medivet 24 Hour Kensington. The whole team were welcoming, professional and genuinely caring throughout. A special thank you to Vishaal Corpaul, who was fantastic. He was incredibly knowledgeable, patient and reassuring, taking the time to explain everything clearly and making sure we felt completely comfortable with the care being given. You can tell he genuinely cares about the animals he treats. Couldn’t have asked for better service and would highly recommend Vishaal and the team at Medivet Kensington.

Fantastic experience with the team at Medivet Kensington. The vets and nurses were exceptionally gentle, thorough, and attentive with my pet, especially Vishaal. You can tell they truly care about the animals they treat. Clean clinic, clear communication, and top-tier service all around!
They have taken great care of my two cats and the hospital saved the life of one of them when seriously ill.
Medivet 24/7 emergency service was excellent, efficient and very helpful.

Medivet Kensington helped me on two separate occasions for my cats and I was so happy they were there to help.

Vish was able to help me and my cat when I thought no other vet clinic would be available to see me. I knew how emergent a blocked cat is, but Vish was able to figure out what was going on, prescribe the appropriate medications, and gave me clear instructions on the next steps.

Another one of my cats potentially ingested some string. After Medivet helped me with my previous cat, I knew exactly where I needed to go. This situation was extremely distressing to me as an owner, but Emma helped me through the entire process. She was extremely transparent with the prices and how each diagnostic test would help us find the string. Having a 24 hour clinic this close to me is a great comfort to me as a pet owner. I will be coming back to them for sure.
Excellent service, looked after my cat and very good at explaining treatment needed, kept my cat relaxed who usually hates vets
Amazing vet clinic! really caring and kind staff.
Great Vets! Cannot recommend enough. My boy is treated so well every time he goes and everyone has a smile on their face. Fantastic service. Never had an issue.

Absolutely the best vets in the area!
Really sad to see people moaning over the cost of emergency appointments, To think this practice is there, 24 HOURS A DAY! 365 DAYS A YEAR!

Amazing staff!!
I came at 3am with an emergency and they were there for me. PRICES are totally REASONABLE considering the fact they never close and always so helpful. Bonnie is a very happy dog since her emergency op!

Worst vet experience I’ve ever had, just a cold cash-grab. I booked an emergency appointment at an extortionate cost for my cat, only to be ignored for 20 minutes while the vet had a loud yell-y non-work conversation with someone.

When the vet finally saw us, he immediately said he couldn’t examine my cat because he was hissing. No other vet has had an issue before. . He blamed me for not warning them ahead of time.  I asked him to try. He took my cat into a separate room for barely two minutes, then returned saying he couldn’t examine his mouth or do any blood tests because apparently they can’t handle a cat?!

I ended up paying the emergency consultation fee plus medication they prescribed without even knowing what was wrong or whether he actually needed pain relief. They then had the nerve to suggest I bring him back in two days for another appointment, despite doing virtually nothing and providing no answers.

Rude, entitled and pointless. Never met a vet that can’t handle a cat.

I had a very disappointing experience at Medivet Kensington after my puppy was involved in a bike accident. The vet suggested hospitalisation overnight to monitor for a possible traumatic brain injury, despite the fact that my puppy had not hit his head. This immediately raised concerns for me, especially as it would have resulted in a very expensive admission.

The following day, I took him to our regular vet for a second opinion. He diagnosed a simple soft tissue injury, did not believe hospitalisation or emergency X-rays were necessary, and recommended conservative management with rest and pain relief.

What upset me most was that I felt unnecessary fear was used to justify expensive treatment options rather than explaining the situation in a balanced way. To make matters worse, I was sent home with medication but no written dosage instructions, leaving me uncertain about how much to give my puppy.

I would strongly recommend seeking a second opinion before agreeing to costly treatment at this clinic.
such a welcome atmosphere staff lovely vet nurse took great care of Molly and explained procedure. and all happy

Absolutely shocking!
Have called out of hours to ask if I can bring now my dog who is unwell and our usual 24 hour Medivet practise is extremely busy at the moment. A woman named Anusha (sorry if it is misspelled) was rude, sounded so patronising and refused to see my dog. I am shocked and on top of this we are paying for these services and for out of hours on top of that.

Had the pleasure of meeting Saul Levy when he was covering at my local Medivet in Muswell Hill at the beginning of June. This was my 3rd visit to Medivet since joining their PetPlan to which I'd mentioned an issue with my cat on each occasion, including at my previous vet (making it the 4th mention in total). Saul had an unbelievable understanding of issues and super quick delivery coming up with a solution where he explains what the problem is and what needs to be done to possibly solve it. I guess all things with animals are trial and error as they cannot always pinpoint the issue straight away, but he has a patient ear when it comes to concerns and validates all what you're doing right and that all concerns are valid! I had lost all hope and could see my cat visibly getting thinner and Saul was the first vet to actually give advice that I could think about and navigate at home to see if it would make a difference. He gave my cats their vaccines with ease and left me with advice of Prednicare, Pro-Kolin Sachets and Hydrolysed protein diet... There is only so much one can Google as by this point I'd tried near thousands of pounds worth of food to see what would make my cat Pixie have less toilet trouble. Nothing worked long-term. The difference is like day and night and I'd forgot a time where my cat was this happy and healthy! Would like to give him the biggest thank you ever - the solution was so simple when he gave advice, and I'm so glad I finally got there because of him! I would trust him with both of my cats lives and listen closely to all his advice. Anyone local to this vet is lucky to have him at their disposal. A great asset to Medivet and a crucial partner to this practice.
A great Vet and excellent review of my dog - thank you.

I am extremely disappointed with the care we received from the night vet, Sebastian. It was the worst and most petrifying veterinary experience I have ever had.

The only reason I’m not giving one star is because of Lacy, the receptionist. She was absolutely incredible—kind, compassionate, knowledgeable and genuinely caring. She explained everything the vet failed to, answered all of our questions, reassured us when we were distressed, and showed genuine concern for our cat. She displayed more professionalism, empathy and knowledge than the vet himself. Quite honestly, Lacy should be the vet, not Sebastian.

Sebastian was rude, dismissive and showed no compassion whatsoever. He repeatedly answered our questions with “I don’t know”, barely examined our cat, didn’t even check her heartbeat, and seemed reluctant to handle her. The examination table was dirty, and when we asked for it to be cleaned, he appeared annoyed.

He also gave our cat an injection without properly explaining what it was or warning us about possible side effects. When we returned the following day because our cat wasn’t herself, he still didn’t explain that her symptoms could be a reaction to the injection—it was Lacy who did.

Instead of making an already distressing situation easier, Sebastian made it far worse. I have never felt so uncomfortable or unsupported at a veterinary practice. Lacy is a true credit to Medivet; Sebastian’s attitude should have no place in a profession that relies on compassion.
Always a positive experience at Medivet… a warm and welcoming atmosphere
Very friendly service, good vets and timely appointments. Can only recommend.
Referred by Parsons Green Medivet for an emergency procedure seen within an hour snd the most efficient vet dealt with the problem immediately. - we are extremely grateful

My pugs have always loved going to Tom at Medivet in Gloucester Road, Kensington because he gives plenty of time and expert attention to their needs. He is always interested in them and understands their problems.

The vets are absolutely  lovely .I can't find fault with any of them VK TOM AND SAUL THEY ARE REALLY GOOD AND YOU CAN DISCUSS  ANYTHING WITH THEM.THEY ALWAYS HAVE TIME FOR YOU AND PUT YOU AT EASE. ALL THE VETS ARE LOVELY  .GET A PET PLAN IT HELPS WITH PRICES I RECOMEND IT AND MEDIVET  AS WELL .

Emma is a star! Never felt so welcomed in a Medivet unit like this before. Friendly, knowledgeable, caring and welcoming.
Made us change practice and opinion about this unit. 5 stars plus!
Medivet Kensington has been attentive and caring towards my cat. The staff is super lovely and friendly ☺️
Thank you for rating us. Your feedback is really appreciated.

The most amazing team of Vets, RVNs, student nurses, patient and client care assistants ever!

I had picked up Toffee from his dog sitters and he had been shaking his head violently and yelped everytime I touched his ear. I called Kensington and they managed to squeeze me into be seen the same day. Toffee was seen promptly and welcomed by Simone. She is the most caring vet and performed a thorough exam on Toff before examining his ear canal. She identified a grass seed right away and took him downstairs to have it removed, the team was so lovely, giving Toffee lots of support and the grass seed was removed smoothly. Toffee was sent home with some pain relief and had plenty of treats by Simone!

I just wanted to thank Medivet Kensington for their kindness and help, to find a good practice is one thing but to find an incredible team is just amazing and we got so lucky to have Kensington as our local practice! Would definitely recommend this practice for those looking for a clinic with staff that treat your pet like their own, thorough investigations and 10/10 care ❤️

I was shocked beyond words and pushed to tears by how rude and unprofessional the staff was here - particularly the American (?) vet nurse.

After I was told to rush my poorly puppy in to the Kensington location (by the Camberwell branch) due to proximity,  I arrived at 3am and politely rang them on the phone to let them know I’d arrived. The nurse  aggressively replied “ um well why did you just show up? You can’t just show up “ etc. and proceeded to storm upstairs and ushered me to have a seat. Not once did she express any concern or acknowledgment for me or my dog.

Regardless of circumstances, regardless of what the nurses were dealing with this is absolutely no way to speak to a patient - particularly in those hours of the night and particularly not when you’re paying an additional fee to be seen overnight . I wouldn’t have shown up unless it felt urgent.

I was assured that my puppy was not as severe or critical as other patients, and sent on my way with probiotics. I never once received a proper apology for the rudeness, simply “ you have to appreciate that from our perspective” etc.

Only a few hours later as she was still not well, I brought my puppy back in to the Islington branch where she was examined and was immediately told she needed to be admitted into hospital urgently.

If I hadn’t trusted my gut, im not sure what would’ve happened to her.

This branch needs to do better and seriously consider addressing their employees attitudes. We’re all humans with emotions, but would it really kill them to lead with some compassion.

I cannot thank the team at Medivet Kensington enough for the care they gave my cat, Kimchi.

After becoming very unwell, Kimchi was admitted to the hospital and eventually underwent surgery. Throughout the entire process, the team were incredibly professional, compassionate, and thorough. They kept me updated regularly, explained everything clearly, and never made me feel rushed when I had questions or concerns.

What stood out most was how much the staff genuinely cared about Kimchi. During her stay, the nurses got to know her personality, gave her plenty of affection, and even told me how much she enjoyed neck scratches and attention from the team. Knowing she was being cared for not just medically, but emotionally as well, meant the world to me during a very stressful time.

The surgeons and veterinary team worked hard to identify the cause of her illness, and I always felt that Kimchi was in the best possible hands. The communication throughout her treatment and recovery was excellent, and I was reassured every step of the way.

Kimchi is now home, recovering well, eating again, and getting back to her normal self. I am incredibly grateful to everyone involved in her care.

Thank you to the vets, nurses, and support staff at Medivet Kensington for your kindness, dedication, and expertise. You helped my best friend when she needed it most, and I will never forget it.

The Medivet team at this practice are excellent--My 2 dogs have been patients there for years. My 12 year old ruptured her ACL and couldn't walk on that leg, so they quickly x-rayed her and recommended surgery to repair the ligament. VK did an outstanding job on the surgery and she is 100% better. The surgery as well as the after care was all amazing.
I have seen some very unfair bad reviews and these are either because they feel the receptionist was rude or that the charges were too high--so they give 1 star. I think the prices are fair--after all, it is a business and not a charity! I have pet insurance, which pays for most of the costs anyway.
I highly recommend Medivet Kensington!
They were fabulous
Staff are all very friendly and kind.  Super nice and understanding to my very nervous dog!  Thank you so much!

I would not recommend this vet.
The prices are extortionate, the staff were not sympathetic, and the overall experience left me even more distressed than I already was. I brought my cat in after he had been hit by a car and was told that I either needed to pay £3,000 just to stabilise him and determine what was wrong, with the possibility of further costs being added on afterwards, or, if I couldn't afford the £3,000, I should put him down.
The vet proceeded to list numerous horrific things that could be happening to my cat without giving me a clear answer about his actual condition. From examining him, I would have expected at least some clarity, but instead I was told that if I took him home, he would likely die overnight.
I was already in tears, and after the vet's explanation, I was completely hysterical. To make matters worse, while my family and I were trying to process everything and make an impossible decision, the vet kept coming back every 20 minutes asking what we had decided after presenting us with a £3,000 estimate simply to "stabilise" my cat.
In the end, I took him home and left having paid £700 for oxygen and pain relief? It felt like there was very little compassion shown during an incredibly upsetting situation, and I left feeling pressured, overwhelmed, and unsupported
Emma Natale was as always the perfect vet. One of the reasons we are at Medivet.
Fantastic experience

Amazing team - thank you all.

These guys are consistently absolutely brilliant.

They even lowered their prices lately!

We always received kind and helpful service. A special thank you to Emma and Olivia for their kindness, professionalism, and patience.
Thank you again for making our experience so pleasant.

Kally Owner – Giovanna Rotundi

Please think twice before trusting Medivet Kensington with your pet’s life or critical paperwork. My cat, Sushi, was hospitalized here in April 2026 and diagnosed with last-stage chronic kidney disease. I paid over thousands here and a vital blood sample was taken for a Rabies Titration Test so I could relocate him to Turkey to receive family-backed supportive care on 14th of April.
For FIVE WEEKS, I was left believing the test was processing. I phoned three separate times in May and was dismissed by staff, told to "stop calling" and wait. On 19/05/2026, they finally admitted they NEVER sent the sample to the lab. It had been sitting in their clinic for over a month, meaning the sample is highly likely unviable and degraded.
When I emailed a formal complaint to management, they completely ignored it. Instead, someone called me to offer a pathetic £180 refund and casually told me the results wouldn't be ready until mid-June.
Sushi has a severe disease. Because of their jaw-dropping administrative incompetence and dismissive communication, his relocation is entirely delayed, putting his fragile life at massive risk. The flight tickets that I have purchased while waiting is a total loss. They do not care about animal welfare, nor do they respect the profound distress of pet owners. I am officially reporting this branch, wanted to write here as well. Avoid this place if your pet needs reliable, professional care.

So seldomly review, but in this instance I cannot help it. Polina, took us in at 11pm and worked patiently and carefully through what was thought to be chocolate ingestion but actually was something totally different. Her diagnostic abilities were beyond, and evaluated the likelihood of chocolate ingestion through memory of my dog’s behaviour that I could just about remember alongside his clinical presentation. Ultimately it was something very different, and very customised to the breed - Pomeranians. Her care was so thorough and measured - and no extreme measures, over prescription, neurosis or unnecessary added costly diagnostics. Every effort was taken to consider his background. We went home, relaxed, stress free and confident - able to actually sleep and not monitor it my dog all night long. This city is SOO lucky to have Polina. Can’t thank her enough.

As usual, friendly and professional service at Medivet Kensington when I brought them our cat for annual vaccination.

I would give six stars if Medivet would give the receptionists a device to open the street door without leaving the desk, as I need both hands to carry a big cat in a cage!
Very fast service and kind personnel.

We’ve been to Medivet for some years now for our cat Mylo and had a really great experience every time, especially ober the last year, as we've seen the same vet. The vet we saw was friendly, professional and genuinely caring with Mylo from the moment we arrived. You can tell she really enjoys what she does and cares about the animals she sees.

She made us feel at ease throughout and gave excellent care and advice. Really appreciated the service we received — 5 stars from us.

Money grabbers, Cane with ny poorly dog, was in tears worried he wont make it, the first thing i was presented with was a Pricelist.... Telling me how much will blood test etc cost me... when i was saying please please check my dog he is dying... all about money no heart at all. AVOID
The vet was great with my Daschund, he is very nervous but she was just firm with him. Fantastic
Caring, kind and highly professional. Everything you would want from a vet
PROFESSIONAL VET, FRIENDLY & CARING Staff
Only place that would actually take in the wounded pigeon I found!

On behalf of my beautiful girls 2 teacup chihuahuas!
All stars 🌟🐾🌟🐾🌟🐾🌟🐾🌟 💝
6 years of attending our amazing Medivet, trusted, reliable, always very supportive and so sweet.  I think my girls are going to vets for socialising, plenty of attention and treats, just help yourself as much as you want.
Annual booster shots done! Going to enjoy lovely weather in the park ☀️🫶

My dog died here. As much as the staff were lovely, the cremation company they use are disgusting and should not be allowed to run. They cremated my dog “accidentally” without the paw print, foam print or farewell that I paid for. As Medivet use this company I’m giving them one star, as they should find another one.

My dog was my life for 12 years, and they destroyed any chance I had of saying goodbye or that others had of saying goodbye.

CHANGE YOUR CREMATION SERVICES.

I’m also still waiting for the refund from all of it, and it’s nearly been a year.
Outstanding, prompt, professional and extremely kind …..from my original call to the receptionist to the lovely friendly and reassuring vet..10/10 …..couldn’t recommend enough 🙏🏻 …
Amazing vet practise! Highly recommended and Tom is a wonderful vet, my dog loves him! He really cares and he is very knowledgeable! Great experience!

If you truly love your pet, this is the place to go. The team at this clinic is exceptional, caring, and professional. ❤️
A very special thank you to Tom, who, even after just a couple of visits, showed outstanding professionalism and kindness. He took the time to follow up, respond to emails, and return calls, which meant so much to me. We’re truly grateful for everything you’ve done for us!
Thank you from both me and Pie 🐶

I came in from another Medivet branch to have my cat treated for a medical emergency. Every single member of the team was incredibly kind and personable in helping both me and my cat.

I am so thankful to the team for their kind care! Thank you, everyone!

My son brought our cat to the vet as he was acting strangely and they found out that he has  hyperthyroidism. I was abroad at that time and they’ve called me to reassure me and also sent me a mail to explain. They were really concerned and careful. Thanks for all your help I really appreciate it
Great team! Took such good care of my Pepper and gave me a lot of reassurance

Emma Natale ( the vet we saw ) was absolutely wonderful with my dog Fido. She reassured me from the moment we arrived that he would be looked after with genuine care and compassion, and she was true to her word. His cyst examination and sample taking were completed quickly and gently, and—miraculously for him—he wasn’t stressed at all, despite usually being very wary of vet visits. I’m so grateful for Emma’s calm, kind approach and the way she handled everything with such professionalism and warmth. Thank you, Emma.

Your team is doing a wonderful job looking after my iggy Xena, from the first day the lovely receptionist who took Xena when I said I needed help, to Dr C Hughes (you have the most gentle manner, I felt that Xena was so safe with you, and you explained everything to me so clearly about her heart murmur) till today when Xena had have further surgery, the lovely lady explained to me what had to happened, I was in shock but she was amazing too. I am so glad I came to your clinic. Thank you team!

We are truly grateful to Vishaal and the team at Medivet for the exceptional care they gave our puppy.

She needed urgent surgery, and throughout the whole process the team showed professionalism, kindness, and genuine care. Vishaal handled everything with great expertise, and we deeply appreciate all the support during such a stressful time.
They have taken great care of Donut, who came both for her eye ulcer and her respiratory illness.

I work in one of the shop in front of Medivet and I found a mouse that was half alive, I brought it to Medivet and the receptionists, all of 3, were AWESOME. They help me and weren't scared or disgusted. Even if they could not do much, because they don't treat small animal, they took and end his/her suffering. So I thank them a lot!
All the team are great at Medivet South Kensington.  They look after my dog extremely well especially Tom

After a few years of taking my dog to this clinic, I decided to stop using its services.  It no longer takes care of dogs during the weekend unless it’s an emergency.  A serious ear infection was not considered an emergency even though my dog was clearly uncomfortable.  As a working person, weekends  suit my schedule better. People at reception desk have also become rude and inflexible. Their attitude is as if they’re doing the customer a favor despite paying higher fees when compared to other veterinary clinics in the area.

as soon as i collected my baby girl from her previous owners, i noticed straight away she wasn’t well at all. the poor girl had come from an abusive household, had a prolapse, had been declawed, severely underweight and had hypothermia. i gave Medivet a ring the next morning and was booked in the same day. as soon as i arrived the staff were so lovely, even gave me some water as i was waiting for the vet. as soon as the receptionist took a look at my kitten, she was brought straight to the vet and nurse for a look.

she had to stay in overnight to be looked over, thankfully they kept me up to date with her condition and told me everything i needed to know about her.

i cannot reccomend this place enough. they really take pride in the comfort and care of your furry friends! my little Ava is doing so much better after her visit and i can’t thank the staff there enough. Especially Emma, the nurse that helped her with everything.

thank you guys so much! she’s absolutely thriving🥰❤️
Took my new puppy here and will continue to do so. The staff are extremely friendly and attentive. You can tell they are all very passionate about animals.
Best clinic in London, they have superstar staff.

Dr Anuska and the blonde nurse (sorry I couldn’t take her name) who saw Carla at 6pm on Sunday 15 February were both amazing. They were so transparent, friendly, and professional throughout the visit. The care they provided truly went above and beyond. We felt completely reassured and grateful for how attentive and kind they were. Thank you for such outstanding service.

No experience, they did 3 exams on my cat and they didn't find the problem, and charged 3 thousands, bring back my cat to home he was almost died,my cat was a throat infection, and find a good vet on YouTube from my country and the vet said to give him antibiotics, so I saved him

After needing an emergency Sunday appointment, I’m changing from my usual vet to this one! 👏

Reception team was so lovely and kind, as well as Cameron who examined my little Prosecco.

Listen, my sausage is VERY anxious and dramatic, she gets stressed when the wind blows too harshly in the park… but surprisingly she behaved way calmer than I expected at Medivet. (compared to my regular vet)

Thanks Cameron for not taking her little tantrum or side eyeing personal! She’s doing better now! Hopefully she’ll stay healthy :)

Have a nice day team! x

Everyone is so kind, friendly, helpful,  efficient and empathetic. You don't feel like you have been rushed through your appointment. I have no worries about leaving my 4 legged fur baby in their very capable hands. We HIGHLY RECOMMEND Medivet Kensington 👌 Thank you ❤️ …

Always feel so relieved at how everyone in the practice loves animals and are so compassionate and understanding. Have been a client for years before they moved to Gloucester road and were on Kynance mews and would highly recommend for any medical pet needs. Thank you!

I had a very disappointing experience with Medivet regarding compounded liquid fluoxetine for my cat. Initially, they provided human liquid fluoxetine, which contains menthol. When I first tried giving it to my cat, he had a strong aversive reaction—his mouth foamed, he threw up, and it stressed him out even more.
Capsules were also not an option, as this is likely to be a long-term treatment and my cat is very difficult to medicate orally. Medivet suggested sprinkling capsules on food, but fluoxetine is bitter, and most cats will not take it even when mixed with their favourite food.

Despite these limitations, Medivet did not take ownership of sourcing a suitable compounded liquid. Instead, I was repeatedly advised to contact online or high-street pharmacies myself, which only supply human formulations unsuitable for cats. This approach delayed my cat’s treatment unnecessarily.

In contrast, another veterinary practice was able to order a tuna-flavoured compounded liquid fluoxetine immediately.

While the vets and staff at this branch are very nice, I got the impression that either they are not fully aware of what’s available in the market or the most up-to-date practices, or that they are too busy to provide a tailored approach appropriate to the individual pet’s needs.

This branch is much better than the Parsons Green branch, which is where I was previously. However, based on what I’ve heard from other pet-owner friends, dissatisfaction with Medivet’s service seems to be common across multiple branches.

That said, I am still choosing to stay with them as I am on a membership plan, and I have found their out-of-hours service and support very helpful in the past—special thanks to Rut, the night vet, who has been fantastic.

So fare so good.
Finally a good Vet experience, after being traumatise, both me and my cats, by very high rated, fancy, very famous, top and very expensive Vets.
Here: a place where you feel they caring for your pet, were they listen, they explain and reassuring you.
Friendly and empathic desk staff, and finally a decent price, also in a wend emergency...
I left without the usual feeling of being  cheated in a delicate moment.
Thanks
Always professional but friendly. I have every confidence in all the vets and staff and kniw that my cat is in very good hands

I visited Medivet Kensington recently with five kittens, born to a stray cat we took in just 20 minutes before she gave birth on the street in Central London. It was their first vaccination, and while the woman we saw—whose name I believe was Nora—was professional, she unfortunately came across as a bit judgmental considering we spent over £700 for vaccinations for 8-week old kittens we took on unexpectedly. We have done our best to take care of them when the shelter we called recommended we keep them at home rather than surrendering if we could manage, which we have so far.

A more serious concern arose with the mother cat, who is with the kittens and lives and belongs to our friend, a first-time cat owner. She was worried the cat might have eaten chocolate as the cat was displaying strange symptoms such as rolling around and looking uncomfortable and, unsure of what was happening, booked an emergency appointment. Being autistic and new to pet ownership, she was understandably anxious and seeking reassurance.
Nora, however, responded in a very dismissive way - asking questions like “did she eat a whole bar?” in a tone that felt more critical than helpful. After briefly checking the cat, she offered two treatment options: an overnight stay costing approximately £1,000 or charcoal. My friend, overwhelmed and worried, chose the charcoal, but it was neither administered at the time nor were clear instructions given on how to use it and was instead given to her and told the instructions were on the box, and left, leaving the £180 bill.
What was most concerning is that the vet missed a very obvious explanation for the symptoms: the cat was in heat. I had gone home for dinner after spending the day with the kittens post-vaccination, but when we arrived shortly after my friend called in distress, we immediately noticed the signs - tail and butt lifted, spraying, general restlessness, etc. These are classic signs of a cat in heat, and any vet should have picked up on this. We had not previously considered this as research had stated that it would likely be not quite so soon after birth, but it has happened. Sharing this information would have spared my friend a great deal of stress and an unnecessary expense of treatment, especially as she had simply accused herself of wrongdoing as to her, the cat looked in pain, when instead it was simply discomfort. After we arrived, my friend told us the symptoms we were seeing were what had been happening prior, and she knew she had not left chocolate lying around after all (and the vet mentioned cats do not usually go for it), she had just wanted answers for the behaviour and had assumed the worst.
Unfortunately, the whole experience left us wishing that the Vet had taken the time to be  compassionate, rather than judgemental, something they can happily do behind staff doors, but teeters on unprofessional and unkind when done in the face of a worried pet parent. Every owner has a unique story, and some understanding should be considered, no matter how many clients have been seen that day. Especially for new pet owners seeking guidance, the lack of empathy and dismissive tone were deeply disappointing.
Otherwise, the practice receptionists are very nice, and another vet, Emma, is incredibly helpful and understanding. Perhaps the vet we saw was exhausted, but she has ruined any relationship my friend has with the practice, and now I will have to take the animals in the future as she does not wish to be unfairly judged again.

I am extremely disappointed with the level of service at the clinic located at 1-3 Gloucester Road, Kensington, London, SW7 4PP. The handling of tests, the cost of services, and the overall quality are far below acceptable standards.

I brought a urine sample from my pet for testing, which, as it turned out, was stored in the refrigerator for over 10 hours and then left on a table at room temperature for another 2 hours. This is a clear violation of established guidelines, as urine tests should be conducted within 1–2 hours of collection, or up to 6 hours in exceptional cases. Despite my concerns, the clinic assured me that the extended storage time would not impact the results.

The cost of this test was £190, which is 3–4 times higher than the average prices across London. At the same time, the responsibility and professionalism of this clinic are 2–3 times lower.

Additionally, I was told that there are no medications available for treating cystitis in cats, which is entirely untrue. After consulting other veterinary practices, I learned about several medications that are effectively used to treat cystitis. After a lengthy argument, the clinic finally prescribed one of these medications, but the dosage was twice the recommended amount, causing complications for my pet. I had to adjust the dosage myself to prevent further harm.

This level of negligence and irresponsible treatment of animals and their owners is unacceptable. I rate this clinic very poorly for its inflated prices, low-quality services, and inability to ensure patient safety. I do not recommend this clinic if you value your pet’s health and your time.
